seniordim.skill.spatial_displacement.des: Rewrite an enemy's coordinates and relocate them 8-12 blocks away to a safe spot. Bosses resist.
seniordim.skill.spatial_compression.desc: Compress the space around one target for 4 seconds: it is pulled inward, heavily slowed and slowly damaged, then thrown back on release.
seniordim.skill.dimensional_barrier.desc: A spherical dimensional boundary absorbs 70% of incoming damage until its durability runs out or 6 seconds pass.
seniordim.skill.dimensional_shift.desc: Step partly out of normal space for 4 seconds: untouchable and unseen, but unable to attack or use abilities.
seniordim.skill.higher_dimensional_perce: Send out a pulse that highlights nearby players and hostile mobs through walls for 5 seconds and reports their direction and distance.
seniordim.skill.dimensional_rupture.desc: Tear a crack in space at the aimed spot. After 1.5 seconds it bursts, hurting and throwing back everything near it.
seniordim.skill.spatial_collapse.desc: Collapse a large area toward one point, pulling enemies in for 3 seconds before a devastating shockwave. Does not destroy terrain.
seniordim.skill.eleventh_dimensional_dom: For 15 seconds your other Senior abilities gain range, radius, targets and barrier durability.
